verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state that Financial Connections gives access to account owners' names and mailing addresses for verifying ownership. An ownership-refresh webhook shows the data can be re-pulled. Contact data on file (email and phone) is not documented, and there is no detail on owner fields or how matching works. Missing for 10: documented retrieval of contact data such as email and phone, detailed docs on ownership fields and matching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer

citations.quote: Access account owners’ names and mailing addresses.
